content.thinking: I've confirmed the credit memo, journal 2490, and the rent invoices are all legitimate, leaving journal 2489 as the one posted after close and outside its period. Next I'll check for other manual postings made after period close and look for any invalid dates.

input.sql: select count(*) filter (where p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."JRNL_NO">2400) late_in_closed, count(*) filter (where i."INV_ID" is not null and h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT") dtmis from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" left join "APINVH" i on i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO"
select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD", v."VEND_NM" from "APINVH" i left join "APVEND" v on trim(v."VEND_CD")=trim(i."VEND_CD") where v."VEND_CD" is null or v."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT", i."STAT_CD" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P'
